name: Chlorproethazine
summary: Chlorproethazine, sold under the brand name Neuriplege, is a drug of the phenothiazine group described as a muscle relaxant or tranquilizer which is or has been marketed in Europe as a topical cream for the treatment of muscle pain. It has been associated with photoallergic contact dermatitis.

uses.text: Chlorproethazine, sold under the brand name Neuriplege, is a drug of the phenothiazine group described as a muscle relaxant or tranquilizer which is or has been marketed in Europe as a topical cream for the treatment of muscle pain.

sideEffects.en: As a skin cream it has been linked to photoallergic contact dermatitis, an itchy rash that appears when treated skin is exposed to sunlight.
sideEffects.zh: 作為外用乳膏，它曾被發現與光過敏性接觸性皮膚炎有關，也就是塗抹處照到陽光後出現的發癢皮疹。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为外用乳膏，它曾被发现与光过敏性接触性皮肤炎有关，也就是涂抹处照到阳光后出现的发痒皮疹。

fact.en: It is a close cousin of chlorpromazine, with two ethyl groups on its side chain nitrogen where chlorpromazine has two methyl groups.
fact.zh: 它是氯丙嗪的近親，差別在於側鏈氮原子上接的是兩個乙基，而氯丙嗪接的是兩個甲基。
fact.zhHans: 它是氯丙嗪的近亲，差别在于侧链氮原子上接的是两个乙基，而氯丙嗪接的是两个甲基。
